name: Nguyễn Văn An
brief:
Born 12 March 1938 · Passed 4 January 2001
Beloved husband, father of three, and retired schoolteacher. Known for his quiet kindness and love of gardening.

name: Trần Thị Bình
brief:
Born 7 July 1942 · Passed 18 August 2015
Devoted wife and grandmother of eight. She made the best bánh xèo in the village.
